question: Estimate the size of the digital-native (mobile-first) consumer segment in Tier 3 + 4 India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Consumers in Tier 3 + 4 cities/towns who primarily transact via mobile apps (e-commerce, payments, OTT)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, app-active (used any non-WhatsApp app monthly): ~75% = ~135M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, conducting at least one e-commerce / OTT / lending / investment transaction monthly: ~70M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~7 crore (70 million) digital-native transacting consumers in Tier 3/4.
